contea di ritrovamento: Oxfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman silver finger ring of Henig Type VIII, of keeled type. The ring is in very good condition and retains evidence of the smith's hammer on the underside of the bezel. It has a large roughly square bezel with faceted edges. The broad triangular shoulders narrow from the bezel and have incised lines and moulded edge decoration based on a stylised leaf design.
